description: Some unit tests are slow on both runners because of Python work, not processes (macOS/ubuntu ratio 1.1 to 1.6). On main at 412bed21: tests/test_url_credential_redaction.py is the slowest unit file on ubuntu (28.9 s summed, 44.7 s on macOS); its doctor-* cases take 2.7 to 3.8 s each on ubuntu and doctor-schemeless and doctor-scheme-relative have identical per-test coverage. tests/test_ledger_query_parity.py (96 cases, 6.8 s ubuntu) re-reads the checkout's real ledgers (about 11,300 rows, growing) in every parametrised case. tests/test_executor_agent_output_redaction.py (5.1 s ubuntu; one case 2.9 s), tests/test_malformed_config_never_crashes.py (3.1 s, three cases), tests/test_ledger_append_only.py (5.3 s; one case 2.3 s), tests/test_makefile.py (35 cases each starting make; 12.1 s on macOS), tests/flow/github/test_merge.py and tests/test_flow_e2e_harness.py (two cases of 3 to 4 s) complete the set: 119.2 s summed on macOS and 57.3 s on ubuntu over 370 cases.
goal: Cut the summed time of the files in scope by at least 35 percent without weakening what they prove: compute expensive invariant inputs once per module (the doctor configuration replay, the parsed real ledgers, the reference query results) and check every case against them; run make once per distinct target where several tests read the same dry-run output; keep every credential shape, prefix and entry point in the redaction matrices (they guard a security rule) and make each case cheaper rather than fewer, unless per-test coverage and the assertion show two cases are the same check. Test code only. Module line budgets (holon-config/hygiene/module_budgets.json) are frozen: that file is never changed; a module this change touches stays within its limit, and new helper code goes into new modules rather than growing an existing one past its limit.
rationale: Expected saving at 35 percent: about 10 s off the ubuntu unit job, about 14 s off the macOS unit job and about 10 s off the workspace-survival job per pipeline run; the ledger parity cost otherwise grows with every ledger row.
acceptance_criteria: The execution notes carry a before and after table per file in scope (summed test time, case count, and the number of git processes started, counted per test with a PATH shim that logs PYTEST_CURRENT_TEST), from 'uv run pytest -n auto --dist worksteal -m "not integration_test and not stress" --durations=0 --junitxml=<report>' on the same machine, median of at least three alternating runs; the summed time of the files in scope is at least 35 percent lower.

Every removed or merged test is listed with the surviving test that proves the same behaviour and the evidence (identical or subset line coverage from a per-test coverage context run, plus the assertion it carried now made by the surviving test). No test that guards a distinct behaviour is removed: a test named for a regression, an incident or an edge case is kept or its assertion is folded into a surviving test, never dropped.
Line and branch coverage of the production modules the files in scope exercise, measured before and after with 'uv run pytest --cov', do not fall.
No file under apps/sandbox-executor/src is changed.
Module line budgets: holon-config/hygiene/module_budgets.json is unchanged and no touched module exceeds its limit.

The whole unit selection passes with 'uv run pytest -n auto --dist worksteal -m "not integration_test and not stress"', the files in scope also pass serially with '-p no:xdist' (no order dependence from shared fixtures), and 'uv run task lint' and 'uv run task lint-docs' pass.

The URL credential matrix still covers every prefix, userinfo form, credential shape, host and suffix it covers today, and a deliberately leaking message (a negative control in the execution notes) still fails it.
